title: Bridge Base Online Board Status Mix
dataSources: BoardGameGeek plays (`bgg:play`), Poker Now sessions (`pokernow:session`), Bridge Base Online boards (`bridgebase:board`), and Lichess tournament rounds (`lichess:tournament`).
app: BoardGameGeek play logs, Poker Now session exports, Bridge Base Online boards, and Lichess tournament data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bridgebase:board
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(board_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the Bridge Base Online board feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `board_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges the overall mood of your Bridge Base Online board feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
